text:
Jaya: quick pulse — thinking about a different webinar format: three 10-min microdemos + 20-min panel instead of a single long demo. keeps momentum and reduces single-demo risk. what do people think?

Leo: love that. reduces blast radius if a demo flaps. can we pair each microdemo with a mini-benchmark slide (latency/cost tradeoff) + one audience takeaway?

Marta: yes. proposal: 1) Onboarding & low-latency tricks, 2) Cost controls & batching, 3) Safety/rollback patterns. each demo 8-10m, 2min segue & 4min quick q. panel for customer stories.

Alex: high-level ask from growth — we need a concise audience-facing abstract and one-sentence TL;DR for social. can someone draft abstracts by EOD Wed?

Jaya: I'll draft the abstracts. rough raws: 
- Microdemo 1: "Ship faster: docker-to-prod patterns for predictable latency" — show trace from request->response and a 2x latency improvement with prefix cache.
- Microdemo 2: "Lower your per-token bill: batching, caching, and quantization choices" — compare naive vs tuned settings and show cost delta.
- Microdemo 3: "Graceful degradation: fallbacks, model routing, and observability" — demonstrate auto-fallback to cheaper variant.

BrandBot: (auto) Reminder: webinar CTA should be a short form -> lead routing to SDR bucket 'webinar_infer_2026'. Confirm routing? :bell:

Sophie: confirm routing. also recommend adding a lightning checklist for hosts: mic check, demo token limit, local mock fallback. I'll spin that up.

Leo: rehearsal plan idea: two async dry runs + one live dress. async dry run = record each microdemo (5–8m) and share. then a 60m live dress 48h before. who needs proctoring?

Marta: product SME + eng oncall on call for dress. recommend Alex as proctor to call time and trigger fallback if a demo stalls.

Alex: happy to proctor. can someone add time markers to the run-of-show so I can cue fallbacks?

Jaya: draft run-of-show (40m):
- 00:00–02:00 Intro + framing (host)
- 02:00–12:00 Microdemo 1 (presenter A) + 3m Q
- 12:00–22:00 Microdemo 2 (presenter B) + 3m Q
- 22:00–32:00 Microdemo 3 (presenter C) + 3m Q
- 32:00–38:00 Panel: customer + eng (moderated)
- 38:00–40:00 Close + CTA

Sophie: nice. please add explicit fallback windows: eg at 01:50 host confirms network/demo health; if not green, jump to pre-recorded clip. also we should have a shortened pre-recorded clip per microdemo (2m) that Alex can play.

Leo: for rehearsals, share a checklist in this thread. quick one:
- recording link + breakglass pre-recorded clips
- speaker mic test (Teams/Zoom)
- model token quota set to <200 tokens during demo
- dev env with fallback endpoint reachable
- slide with 'what to do if demo fails' visible to host

Marta: speaker sourcing updates: invited two customers (FinOps startup + marketplace) for panel; waiting on confirmations. also reached out to 3 internal engs for microdemos, two confirmed. need one external early-stage founder for real-app story.

Jaya: audience abstract drafts for social (short):
- "How teams ship LLM features at predictable cost & latency — 3 microdemos, practical takeaways."
- "Real demos, real tradeoffs: batching, fallbacks, and observability for inference."

BrandBot: (auto) Note: marketing copy approval required by legal for claims referencing benchmarks. Tag @Legal if you include specific numbers.

Alex: good point — keep public social copy qualitative. we can include numbers in the follow-up blog with proper bench notes.

Sophie: next steps: Jaya to post abstracts by EOD Wed, Marta to finalize speakers by Thu noon, Alex to prepare fallback clips by Fri, Leo to set rehearsal slots Mon/Tue next week. I'll compile a rehearsal matrix doc and share link here when ready.

Marta: ok booking windows now. ping me with constraints.

Jaya: thanks team — this format feels lean. small ask: can marketing own the attendee questions triage during the panel?

Leo: marketing can triage, product will answer tech questions.

BrandBot: (auto) Scheduled reminder set for rehearsal 48h prior: 2939991145.

Alex: perfect. thanks all :rocket:
